stem:
Actin is a protein that helps the cell maintain its shape and polarity. It also plays a major role in muscle contraction. A table summarizing the cellular functions of different types of proteins is shown.

Based on this information, actin is most likely —
visual_elements: Enzyme proteins | Increase the rate of chemical reactions
Structural proteins | Provide structure and support for cells; on a larger scale, allow the body to move
Messenger proteins | Transmit signals to coordinate biological processes between different cells, tissues, and organs
Transport proteins | Bind and carry atoms and small molecules within cells and throughout the body
